name: Tricubic B-Spline Interpolation
definition: A GPU-accelerated interpolation method using uniform cubic B-splines to sample a 3D volume texture, providing smoother results than linear interpolation while being faster than full tricubic convolution.
summary: Tricubic B-Spline Interpolation is a GPU-accelerated method that samples 3D volume textures using uniform cubic B-splines, offering smoother results than linear interpolation while requiring fewer texture fetches than full tricubic convolution.
